records.prompt: A seamless tileable grayscale sci-fi spaceship armor ALBEDO MATERIAL texture, orthographic flat surface scan, square full bleed. Fine precision-machined titanium alloy panels, restrained brushed grain, subtle hairline seams, a few tiny recessed screws, narrow inset vent slits, crisp bevel-edge wear and layered rectangular plate boundaries. Large quiet light-silver metal fields occupying 80 percent, dark detail occupying at most 20 percent, material luminance mostly 0.65 to 0.95 so it can be multiplied by arbitrary colored ship paint. Sophisticated premium hard-surface spacecraft skin, not rusty, not grungy. Texture details must read on a 200-pixel game spaceship without becoming noise. NO spaceship, no object silhouette, no perspective, no cast shadows, no environment, no lettering, no numbers, no emissive lights, no logos, no borders. Even diffuse lighting, perfect edge-to-edge tileability.
